description: device.activate.v1: apply a device configuration for a deployment generation. Producer: control plane (DeviceAudit::enqueue from DeviceConfigurationService::activate for configure and rollback, and DeviceLifecycleService::request for resume), claimed through POST /api/internal/devices/outbox/claim and republished on iot.control.device.activate.v1. Consumer: runtime devices-control (handleControl), which reads definition, generation and operation_uuid. At least once; deduplicate by uuid (the outbox row, Nats-Msg-Id). Fences: generation and operation_uuid.

lease_token.description: The claim lease: present on rows returned by POST /api/internal/devices/outbox/claim and in the message the runtime republishes; the runtime sends it back to acknowledge the row. Absent on a row that was never claimed.
